title: AISP deployment-approval response envelope
description: Extracted from examples/aisp-deployment-approval/deployment_approval_example.py (v2). This is the structured human-approval payload that rides inside sys.io.confirm after the leading approve/reject/modify token. Signed fields are listed in SIGNED_FIELD_NAMES; display_note is presentational and unsigned; signature covers the signed subset only.

decision.description: Control-flow decision. reject/modify are routing tokens on the raw USER_ANSWER, not this envelope.

approver.description: Declared approver identity. A signature over this string is not IdP authentication.

approved_scope.description: Load-bearing subset of the plan the human approved. Independently checked against the current plan AND against plan_sha256.

approval_conditions.description: Signed, load-bearing conditions (maintenance window, instance cap, ...).

public_key.description: x-only secp256k1 hex the verifier actually checks (BIP-340). Not the same as key_id.

key_id.description: Opaque registry label. Not key material.

signature.description: BIP-340 Schnorr signature hex over sha256(JCS-safe-canon(signed_fields)).

display_note.description: Presentational, UNSIGNED. A typo fix here must not invalidate a real approval.
